Commands, flags, file paths and config keys stay verbatim. One status line about message screening. {held}, {breaker} and {rejected} are the three already-translated fragments below; keep the ' · ' separators and their order.

cli.team_bridge.status.screening_healthy.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge; 'receiver' is the background process that delivers messages. Commands, flags, file paths and config keys stay verbatim. The status line when no screened message is held and none was rejected in the last 24 hours. 'Screening' is the safety check every incoming agent message passes; 'breaker' is the circuit breaker that pauses screening after repeated provider failures.

cli.team_bridge.status.screening_held.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge; 'receiver' is the background process that delivers messages. Commands, flags, file paths and config keys stay verbatim. Messages parked by screening, waiting to be retried. {codes} is a verbatim list of technical hold codes with counts (e.g. 'breaker_open 9, provider_error 3'); {age} is a compact duration like '41m'. Never translate the codes.

cli.team_bridge.status.screening_held_cl.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge; 'receiver' is the background process that delivers messages. Commands, flags, file paths and config keys stay verbatim. As screening_held, plus {failure_class}: the verbatim technical code of the most common provider failure among held messages. Never translate it.

cli.team_bridge.status.screening_held_no.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge; 'receiver' is the background process that delivers messages. Commands, flags, file paths and config keys stay verbatim. Fragment: no message is parked by screening.

cli.team_bridge.status.screening_breaker.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge; 'receiver' is the background process that delivers messages. Commands, flags, file paths and config keys stay verbatim. Fragment: the screening circuit breaker. open = screening paused for {remaining} (compact duration like '4m'); failing = closed but with recent provider failures; other = closed and healthy.

cli.team_bridge.status.screening_rejecte.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge; 'receiver' is the background process that delivers messages. cli.team_bridge.notify.probe_suspected_t.role: local owner notification (inbox item) raised by the agent-messages receiver
cli.team_bridge.notify.probe_suspected_t.tone: calm, factual, operator-facing; no alarm, no blame
cli.team_bridge.notify.probe_suspected_t.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge. Title of an inbox notification shown ONLY to the owner of the receiving agent when Radient's hub flags that one SENDER collected several moderation refusals from this agent in 24h, counted across all conversations. 'Probing' = someone testing what the agent's moderation lets through, one attempt at a time. Never names the sender, the message or the category.

cli.team_bridge.notify.probe_suspected_b.role: local owner notification (inbox item) raised by the agent-messages receiver
cli.team_bridge.notify.probe_suspected_b.tone: calm, factual, operator-facing; no alarm, no blame
cli.team_bridge.notify.probe_suspected_b.note: Body of the same owner-only notification. Three facts must survive: (1) the owner's agent moderation refused several messages from the SAME sender in the last day (possibly across different conversations); (2) that pattern can mean someone is testing what the agent accepts; (3) that sender is no longer told WHY their messages are refused (the hub withholds the reason). Do not imply the sender was notified or blocked, and do not name a conversation.

cli.team_bridge.notify.budget_exhausted_.role: local owner notification (inbox item) raised by the agent-messages receiver
cli.team_bridge.notify.budget_exhausted_.tone: calm, factual, operator-facing; no alarm, no blame
cli.team_bridge.notify.budget_exhausted_.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge. Title shown ONLY to the owner of the receiving agent, once, when the agent's hourly screening budget (how many moderation checks its on-device screener may run per hour) is used up. 'Screening' = the moderation check every incoming agent message passes before the agent may read it. Temporary: it clears on its own.

cli.team_bridge.notify.budget_exhausted_.role: local owner notification (inbox item) raised by the agent-messages receiver
cli.team_bridge.notify.budget_exhausted_.tone: calm, factual, operator-facing; no alarm, no blame
cli.team_bridge.notify.budget_exhausted_.note: Body of the same notification. Three facts must survive: (1) the hourly screening budget is used up, so NEW agent messages wait unscreened; (2) nothing is lost: they are screened automatically as the budget refills; (3) messages from people, and messages addressed to the owner's agent (a mention or a direct message), are screened before other agent chatter. Do not imply messages were rejected, deleted or that anyone was notified.

cli.team_bridge.notify.screening_model_u.role: local owner notification (inbox item) raised by the agent-messages receiver
cli.team_bridge.notify.screening_model_u.tone: calm, factual, operator-facing; no alarm, no blame
cli.team_bridge.notify.screening_model_u.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge. Title shown ONLY to the owner of the receiving agent when NO approved screening model is available, so every incoming agent message is held. 'Screening' = the moderation check every incoming agent message passes before the agent may read it. NOT temporary: it stays until the owner acts. 'Held' is the namespace's term for a message that has not reached the agent.

cli.team_bridge.notify.screening_model_u.role: local owner notification (inbox item) raised by the agent-messages receiver
cli.team_bridge.notify.screening_model_u.tone: calm, factual, operator-facing; no alarm, no blame
cli.team_bridge.notify.screening_model_u.note: Body of the same notification. Facts that must survive: (1) screening now runs only on models tested for it, named exactly: Claude Opus 5.5 or Claude Sonnet 5.5, via Anthropic or Radient (product and model names stay in Latin script, untranslated); (2) none is available here, so new agent messages are held; (3) nothing is lost; (4) the fix: sign in to Anthropic, OR on Radient set the default model to one of those two; Radient's automatic model ('auto') is NOT used for screening; (5) held messages are re-screened once a model is available. Do not imply messages were rejected, deleted, or that a human reviews them.

cli.team_bridge.notify.screening_credit_.role: local owner notification (inbox item) raised by the agent-messages receiver
cli.team_bridge.notify.screening_credit_.tone: calm, factual, operator-facing; no alarm, no blame
cli.team_bridge.notify.screening_credit_.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge. Title shown ONLY to the owner of the receiving agent when the screening call through their Radient account was refused for insufficient credit (HTTP 402). 'Screening' = the moderation check every incoming agent message passes before the agent may read it. Not temporary: it stays until the owner adds credit or signs in to Anthropic.

cli.team_bridge.notify.screening_credit_.role: local owner notification (inbox item) raised by the agent-messages receiver
cli.team_bridge.notify.screening_credit_.tone: calm, factual, operator-facing; no alarm, no blame
cli.team_bridge.notify.screening_credit_.note: Body of the same notification. Facts that must survive: (1) the safety check runs on an approved model through the owner's Radient account; (2) that account lacks credit for it, so new agent messages are held; (3) nothing is lost AND no other model is used instead (this is deliberate: screening never falls back to an unapproved model); (4) the fix: add credit in the Radient console, or sign in to Anthropic; (5) held messages are re-screened automatically. Product names (Radient, Anthropic) stay in Latin script. Do not imply messages were rejected or deleted.
